en: Ha! You got all three of my new workers fired up. Nothing like a battle to get the blood pumping!
Hey there, Trainer! Your Pokémon look full of beans. My new workers, not so much.
There are three of them dawdling round the complex. Battle them and get them going, would you?
Heat crude oil, and it separates into all its parts. That's what the tall tower over there is for!
Oh! You heard all that? My knowledge just overflows sometimes.
The smokestacks rise right into the sky! Breathtaking, aren't they? They burn off the waste gas, you know.
Those round gas holders are so harmonious! A sphere stands up best to the pressure inside it.
You keep listening to me! Does that make us complex buddies? Here, a present for my new friend!
The foreman wanted to hire me, but I'm happy just looking at the place!
